lAgendary.name: L'Agendary
lAgendary.tagline: An event management web app built for groups.
lAgendary.description:
L'Agendary lets you create and manage events, public or private, and find them through filtered search.

Each user has a personal calendar gathering their events and invitations. Private events work through email invitations. A backoffice handles account and content administration.

Group project: Next.js front end, Symfony API, MySQL database, all containerised with Docker. JWT authentication.

dispoIntervenants.name: Lecturer availability manager
dispoIntervenants.tagline: Managing university lecturer availability, without friction.
dispoIntervenants.description:
Each lecturer enters their availability via a personal access key, no account needed. An admin dashboard gives programme managers the full picture.

The app handles JSON data import and export. Development was iterative, across 21 documented iterations.

nintendo.name: Nintendo product page
nintendo.tagline: Pixel-perfect recreation of the Stardew Valley page from the Nintendo store.
nintendo.description:
A front-end precision exercise: faithfully recreating the Stardew Valley product page from the Nintendo store across its three responsive layouts — desktop, tablet and mobile.

Meticulous integration work: grids, typography, carousels and interactive states, as close to the original as possible. For study purposes.

robinLeRequin.name: M'T Dents — Robin the shark
robinLeRequin.tagline: Teaching 3–6 year-olds to brush their teeth, playfully.
robinLeRequin.description:
Educational app for children aged 3–6: a tooth-brushing timer led by Robin the shark, learning cards and an interactive quiz.

Built from Figma mockups, designed for tablet and mobile, with special care for toddler accessibility (large touch targets, visual feedback).

ecoQuest.name: Eco-Quest
ecoQuest.tagline: A VR game on a desert island, in support of an ecological message.
ecoQuest.description:
Virtual reality game built in a trio: the player explores a desert island and must collect the waste polluting it to clear each level.

Built with A-Frame (WebVR), playable in a headset or a browser. The gameplay carries a message: raising awareness of pollution in natural environments.

tsudoi.name: Tsudoi (集い)
tsudoi.tagline: A manga reading tracker to share with friends.
tsudoi.description:
Tsudoi (Japanese for 'gathering') is a manga reading tracker built for circles of friends: reading log, micro-reviews, and discovery through what your circle reads.

Currently in development — Next.js and Supabase (auth, database, realtime).

irminsul.name: Irminsul
irminsul.tagline: A Discord bot for Genshin Impact info and builds.
irminsul.description:
Irminsul answers slash commands with Genshin Impact character info and builds, with game data synchronisation.

Run with real engineering rigour: strict TypeScript, automated tests, linting, continuous integration.
